title: Cobbleverse Economy and Department Stores
subtitle: Player Guide
keywords: a version-specific guide to cobbledollars merchant categories generated shop search randomized inventories progression purchases and a reproducible budgeting method

cobbledollars are an account balance shown in merchant interfaces not an inventory stack the verified 1 7 42 first-session screen began at zero and the bundled cobbledollars/common json enables earnings from npc battles and wild-pok mon battles the data does not justify promising a fixed payout for every opponent so plan from the bank value actually shown in game
this guide explains purchase decisions the shop browser /battle-shops/shops remains the authority for current generated prices and merchant placement

the generated department-store file groups offers by store family and merchant the current families include farmers market regular store workers randomized store workers relic store workers and randomized relic store workers each merchant record carries its display name offer categories item ids prices counts source file and whether it is randomized examples include apricorn/seed sellers master of stones tm archivist battle-item sellers held-item sellers vitamins food technology and other specialist inventories a category name is not proof that every settlement has the same worker

open battle shops /battle-shops select shops and search by item or merchant the results table displays item price merchant and store from frontend/public/department stores json search before traveling so you know which worker name and store family to inspect

the type gems item page /items/gems links the stable acquisition guidance to the same live browser for moves and abilities use the dedicated move shops /battle-shops/moves and ability shops /battle-shops/abilities views
prioritize early mid and late purchases

use criteria rather than a fixed shopping list - early progression protect the starting supply buy only what directly restores your next attempt enables a documented locator recipe or replaces an exhausted capture resource - mid progression spend on repeatable team infrastructure needed tms held items evolution/form requirements or recipe materials after checking that the chosen pok mon can use them - late progression reserve costly specialist materials for a confirmed legendary form or region objective follow the exact guide before purchasing multiple components the progression overview /guides/progression identifies the active checkpoint practical team building /guides/team-building helps decide whether a move or item solves that matchup a purchase is progression-critical only when the authoritative trainer legendary location or item guide names it

do not infer acquisition from a recipe screenshot use maintained pages - locator chip /items/locator-chip for the poke radar component and current loot sources - type gems /items/gems for gem purchasing and loot context used by many radar/tm recipes - plates /items/category/plate for sinnoh and arceus-related acquisition routes - structures and radars /guides/structures-and-radars for target-specific locator requirements - legendary encounters /guides/legendary-spawning before buying materials for a summon or structure route if a named ingredient has no item page search its exact displayed name in the live shop browser and then verify the recipe against the current walkthrough

store families whose generated id ends in random contain merchants marked israndomized true their presence in the data means the offer belongs to a randomized pool it does not promise that one permanent worker always carries it search results may show the same item in fixed and random store families for a reliable plan prefer a fixed store workers or relic store workers result when one exists if only a randomized result exists visit another appropriate store or wait for the server s documented refresh behavior this repository does not currently verify a universal refresh interval

at the 2026-07-30 snapshot filtering the generated shop browser for gem shows the master of stones listing type gems at 25 000 cobbledollars each a plan to buy one water gem one grass gem and one fighting gem therefore requires text 25 000 25 000 25 000 75 000 cobbledollars this is a dated example not a permanent promise reopen the live gem search /battle-shops/shops search gem copy the three displayed prices and recalculate before buying if the bank is below the total rank the gems by the next verified recipe or matchup and purchase only the first required one the linked table not this dated arithmetic is authoritative after data regeneration

- no search result check spelling and try the item namespace-free display name then inspect its item/guide page for loot or crafting alternatives - merchant name exists but worker is absent verify the store family and whether the result is randomized search another generated merchant source rather than assuming every department store is identical - price differs in game record the installed cobbleverse version server rules merchant name and displayed offer a server may run changed data - balance does not increase confirm the battle type and the account bank display the current config enables npc and wild-battle earnings but does not establish one payout amount - ingredient purchased but recipe fails compare item identity quantity and version with the exact progression or legendary guide - unresolved discrepancy attach a privacy-safe screenshot and source route to the correction form /contact omitting server addresses and account details

cobbleverse progression is organized into four regional series kanto johto hoenn and sinnoh each visible series follows the same shape eight gym leaders in numbered order four elite four members in numbered order then one champion the site s regional directory /progression-guide and region pages preserve that order from the generated region data the active trainer card is the first place to check in game match the region and named checkpoint on the card to the same region page on this site the verified 1 7 42 first-session card began in kanto with brock a current cap of 25 and a 30 cap after victory

this overview was reconciled against the exact rct and regional datapacks installed in cobbleverse 1 7 42 the older kanto johto hoenn and sinnoh screenshots already in the repository are useful visual records but only the dated trainer card capture above has exact 1 7 42 in-game provenance current-version ordering rosters level caps locator recipes and advancement links come from the matching installed-profile files rather than from screenshot appearance alone

all four region routes exist a route existing does not mean every checkpoint has an authored walkthrough region visible chain source level band current detail coverage --- --- --- --- kanto /progression-guide/kanto 8 gyms 4 elite four 1 champion 16 100 all 13 records and legacy recipe/location/trainer images are present no per-trainer authored guide md walkthroughs yet johto /progression-guide/johto 8 gyms 4 elite four 1 champion 19 100 all 13 records and legacy recipe/location/trainer images are present no per-trainer authored guide md walkthroughs yet hoenn /progression-guide/hoenn 8 gyms 4 elite four 1 champion 20 100 all 13 visible checkpoints have authored walkthroughs a separate hidden lyris data record has no authored walkthrough and is not part of the visible chain sinnoh /progression-guide/sinnoh 8 gyms 4 elite four 1 champion 28 100 all 13 visible checkpoints have authored walkthroughs kanto and johto are therefore usable data-and-image references not complete authored walkthroughs their pages can identify order rosters caps biomes and legacy recipe imagery but they do not yet provide the same step-by-step route loot and troubleshooting coverage as hoenn and sinnoh

the four broad level bands above are authored fields in each region json the parser copies them unchanged and the region loader sorts by the minimum they are not recalculated at runtime from the opponent roster and are not a promise that one level is safe for every fight use the selected checkpoint s revealed team for the actual opponent levels the site s level cap is a generated planning value the parser takes the highest level in that checkpoint s bundled rct roster adds five and caps the result at 100 it is not copied from an in-game cap field brock s generated site value is 25 which matches the active 25 shown on the verified trainer card that card separately shows a 30 cap after victory follow the active cap shown in game when it differs from the site s planning value and do not read either value as a recommended team level before a fight - confirm the trainer card and site page name the same region and trainer - reveal the current trainer s team instead of relying on the region-wide band - keep the party within the active cap shown in game and - prepare for the listed roster abilities held items and off-type coverage

gym and league structures use named locator items their current-profile recipes attach a target structure to the crafted output the in-game tooltip then directs the player to insert that item into a regional cartography table open the correct region page select the active trainer and use its first recipe or locator step before following the resulting map petra s exact installed 1 7 42 recipe is a useful example two paper one pink apricorn and three stone slabs craft the rock tome whose bundled result targets the petra structure

the hoenn and sinnoh authored checkpoints show materials and route steps directly kanto and johto currently expose legacy recipe images without authored prose so read those pages as visual/data references and do not assume an undocumented route detail elite four members normally share their region s league structure once inside continue through the numbered rooms rather than searching for four independent buildings when a step requires a documented collectible use the linked site inventory rather than guessing an acquisition route the plates category /items/category/plate covers progression-linked sinnoh plates while the broader items directory /items and global search help resolve named materials

use this short decision loop - open the trainer card and note the active region trainer and cap - open that region s page and select the same trainer - if the trainer is a gym leader craft or obtain the locator shown in that checkpoint and find its structure - if the trainer is elite four or champion follow the shared league route and room order shown on the region page - after winning confirm the trainer card changed before preparing for the generated nexttrainerid the badge case is a useful confirmation for gym victories but the trainer card remains the authoritative next-checkpoint display

activate altars in the documented order

an altar may consume or transform a prerequisite produce a reward or lock an alternative dialga demonstrates an ordered sequence place the adamant orb first then use the red chain regieleki and regidrago demonstrate a choice activating one altar removes the other in that temple
do not infer consumption or repeatability from a different altar keep backup supplies only when the individual walkthrough verifies a repeatable acquisition path

the legendary beasts and galarian birds are documented conditional natural-spawn groups not altar summons their guide data identifies separate time or weather modifiers a multiplier changes relative selection it is not a guaranteed spawn or a published catch-rate promise

mewtwo is produced through a multi-block cloning setup the machine has its own materials loading order progress display and variant catalysts a radar or generic altar item is irrelevant

title: Practical Team Building in Cobbleverse
subtitle: Player Guide
keywords: a progression-focused method for choosing roles checking type and damage balance using the site s team builder warnings and preserving individual pok mon state in the local pc
define the job before picking six

a useful team is built for a task the next trainer a structure route catching or general exploration start with the active checkpoint in the progression overview /guides/progression open that trainer s revealed roster and note the active in-game cap do not treat this guide as a universal competitive tier list for each planned member write one primary job physical damage special damage fast cleanup defensive switch recovery/support status or capture utility one pok mon can cover multiple jobs but every slot should have a reason to exist for the selected objective
check type coverage and role balance

open team builder /team-builder add the pok mon you actually own or can obtain and inspect both offensive and defensive coverage the tool calculates move-based offensive coverage pok mon-type coverage and defensive profiles ability modifiers are applied where the tool has matching data

coverage is a diagnostic not a score a team with many super-effective move types can still fail if every attacker is slow fragile or dependent on the same damage category add resistance or immunity pivots for repeated weaknesses then decide whether the route actually requires that change
balance physical special speed and bulk

compare attack and special attack before assigning damage moves if every damaging member uses the same category a single defensive profile can stall the team keep at least one credible physical and one special route when the target roster makes that useful then check - speed identify who acts early and who can safely finish weakened targets - bulk decide which member can enter against each repeated enemy type - recovery distinguish direct recovery from one-use items or passive healing - status and utility reserve moves for sleep paralysis screens hazards removal or capture only when the planned encounter benefits - accuracy and setup time do not count a move as reliable merely because its maximum damage is high
use only available forms moves abilities and items

the editor exposes the current pok mon/form record ability choices up to four moves held item level nature evs ivs and tera type the site s data can show that a move or ability belongs to a bundled learnset it cannot prove you have already unlocked the required tm tutor item or form trigger in your world follow the relevant pok mon page /pokemon and items directory /items before finalizing a hard-to-obtain component search move shops /battle-shops/moves and the shop browser /battle-shops/shops for generated availability a legal-looking build that depends on late materials is not an early-progression recommendation

the export validation currently checks - duplicate species as a warning - team-member ev totals above 510 as errors - any individual ev above 252 as an error - levels outside 1 100 as errors - selected abilities that may not be available on the chosen form and - selected moves that may not appear in that form s learnset warnings are invitations to inspect not proof of illegality on every server the duplicate-species message explicitly refers to formats that use species clause cobbleverse progression itself is not declared to use one universal competitive ruleset resolve hard ev/level errors then verify availability warnings against the current pok mon record and your server
preserve an individual pok mon in pc

use pc /pc when the exact caught or trained instance matters the current first version saves individual pok mon with move progression battle state and notes it supports local save edit duplicate delete and moving entries between boxes cloud sync is explicitly unavailable so browser data is not an in-game transfer or a backup on another device
the team builder is a plan for a lineup the pc is a record of a specific individual updating one does not claim to update the other or the minecraft save
adapt a team for brock worked example

this example uses transparent criteria for the first documented kanto objective brock /progression-guide/kanto trainer kanto brock his bundled roster is geodude level 16 bonsly level 16 with focus sash cranidos level 18 and onix level 20 with rocky helmet the site s generated planning cap is 25 the verified trainer card separately shows the active in-game cap which remains authoritative start with three obtainable early candidates rather than a claimed best six candidate proposed job why it is being tested --- --- --- squirtle /pokemon/7 bulky water damage water targets the rock/ground members and offers a defensive starting point bulbasaur /pokemon/1 grass special damage and utility grass supplies another route into rock/ground while leaving room for status or recovery mankey /pokemon/56 physical fighting pressure tests a physical answer for rock targets instead of relying only on special damage in team builder set each member to its real level and actual learned moves search generated move availability rather than assigning an assumed set for example inspect water moves /battle-shops/moves search water grass moves /battle-shops/moves search grass and fighting moves /battle-shops/moves search fighting leave held-item slots empty unless the item is already obtained brock s trainer context /progression-guide/kanto trainer kanto brock warns that focus sash and sturdy can prevent a clean one-hit plan the selection criteria are matchup coverage mixed physical/special pressure survival at the active cap and actual availability fill remaining slots with caught pok mon that patch the team builder s defensive gaps or provide healing/capture utility re-run the warnings after every move form or ability change

- starting from six favorites with no task choose the checkpoint first then justify each slot - counting types but not moves a pok mon s type does not guarantee a currently learned super-effective move - ignoring damage category avoid assigning special moves to a member selected only for high attack or the reverse without a reason - planning at level 100 set actual current levels and obey the active in-game cap - treating warnings as server law fix numerical errors and verify availability do not invent a universal format - using unobtained items follow generated item/shop links and keep the slot empty until the route is realistic - assuming pc means cloud or game sync it is a local planning record in the current implementation - never revisiting the plan after a loss record what failed speed bulk coverage item availability or execution and change the smallest relevant part
